svg.text: Pick cell - two tracking delta robots (N+1) on a portal
OK - row emptied in the pick window: 30.5 s >= 6 takts = 24 s delta C takes one cookie per takt; a row never reaches the nose
OK - cookie at the picker: max 37.5 C after 68 s on the loop <= T_PACK 38 C a warm cookie sealed in film sweats (condensate in the pack)
OK - pick capacity, ONE delta: 0.50 /s >= demand 0.25 /s N+1: either delta alone carries the line
OK - tracking window per delta: 95 mm = 4.8 s >= reach+grip 0.8 s chord of the reach circle over the back run
I/O: CAM2, CAM4, NFC-R, delta_A.M-15, delta_A.M105, delta_A.M225, delta_A.VAC, delta_B.M165, delta_B.M285, delta_B.M405, delta_B.VAC
Parts: delta_A x22, delta_B x22, portal x10, sensor x1, vision x2
